focus_areas: Bone surface texture and porosity (material realism)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus on the distinction between a real fossil photograph and an AI generation. Real fossils have specific lighting reflections on bone, dust textures, and museum armature (metal supports). AI generations often smooth out these imperfections or generate nonsensical metal supports. Check if the bone texture looks like porous fossilized bone or smooth plastic/clay. Verify that the metal support structures are physically plausible and correctly attached to the skeleton. Ensure no soft tissue features (skin, scales) are hallucinated onto the bare bones.
